description: Raw physical hit points of the vessel.
mechanic: Each tag adds +500 HP to base hull. Hull damage is applied after armor reduction.

interactions.effect: Armor reduces incoming damage before it reaches hull, making each HP point more effective.
Passive repair restores hull over time; higher hull pools benefit more from sustained repair.
Nanite swarms target hull for restoration; larger hull pools absorb more nanite repair.

description: Flat percentage reduction to incoming physical and kinetic damage.
mechanic: Each tag adds +4% damage reduction, applied multiplicatively. Hard cap at 60%.

interactions.effect: Armor amplifies the effective value of every hull point by reducing damage taken.
Corrosive attacks reduce armor % temporarily, lowering this tag's effectiveness.
Compressed enemy clusters deal collision damage; armor reduces this incoming impact.

description: Maximum energy shield capacity.
mechanic: Each tag adds +300 SP to base shield pool. Shields absorb damage before hull.

interactions.effect: Larger shield pools take longer to refill; regen rate must scale with shield max.
A high shield max is wasted if delay prevents regen from starting promptly.
Hyper-Conductor converts shield pressure into voltage output — larger pools generate more power under fire.

description: Rate at which shields restore when not taking damage.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20 SP/s to shield regeneration rate.

interactions.effect: Regen rate is irrelevant until delay expires; reduce delay to get value from high regen.
Cooldown reduction on shield-triggered abilities pairs with fast regen for rapid recovery cycles.
Fast regen means ON_SHIELD_DROP triggers fire more frequently, enabling reactive builds.

description: Time delay before shield regeneration begins after taking damage.
mechanic: Each tag reduces delay by 0.3s. Minimum delay is 0.5s.

interactions.effect: Lowering delay unlocks the value of high regen — both tags synergise for fast shield cycling.
Phase state prevents incoming damage, resetting delay and allowing shields to begin regen sooner.
Dodging incoming hits avoids triggering delay, keeping regen active longer.

description: Maximum forward velocity.
mechanic: Each tag adds +30 u/s to maximum speed.

interactions.effect: Higher top speed is only usable if acceleration can reach it before the next engagement.
Higher mass increases momentum at top speed, amplifying collision damage with IMPACT_DRIVE.
Speed and evasion together make a ship hard to hit; each reinforces the other defensively.

description: Rate at which top speed is reached.
mechanic: Each tag adds +25 u/s² to acceleration.

interactions.effect: Acceleration determines how quickly top speed is reached and how responsive direction changes feel.
High acceleration lets the ship exploit a blink repositioning immediately without losing momentum.
Higher mass reduces acceleration's effectiveness; heavy ships need more tags to feel responsive.

description: Angular handling and rotation speed.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20 °/s to rotation rate.

interactions.effect: Turn speed and evasion together let a ship dodge by steering as well as by RNG — complementary defensive layers.
Higher turn speed makes frontal-arc weapons easier to aim at fast-moving targets.
High mass penalises turn speed; extra TURN_SPEED tags help compensate on heavier hulls.

description: Percentage chance to completely dodge an incoming attack.
mechanic: Each tag adds +3% dodge chance. Hard cap at 45%. A successful dodge prevents all damage from that hit.

interactions.effect: Evasion tags count toward unlocking phase-linked upgrades; high evasion enables phase keystone paths.
Evasion reduces the frequency of shield-drop events, making ON_SHIELD_DROP triggers more deliberate.
A dodge that would have been lethal can be followed immediately by a blink to reposition.

description: Vessel mass affecting momentum drift and collision physics.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 mass unit. Higher mass increases collision damage dealt and momentum carry, but reduces turn responsiveness.

interactions.effect: Mass × velocity at impact determines collision damage output with IMPACT_DRIVE.
Graviton Weaver compression pulls enemies into the flight path; more mass means higher impact damage.
Each mass tag slightly reduces effective turn speed; offset with TURN_SPEED tags for brawler builds.

description: Capacity limit for small weapon and module hardpoints.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 small hardpoint slot.

interactions.effect: Small slots often host rapid-fire weapons; RATE_OF_FIRE tags multiply their output.
Small slots can house drone launchers; more slots let a ship run multiple drone types simultaneously.

description: Capacity limit for medium weapon and module hardpoints.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 medium hardpoint slot.

interactions.effect: Medium weapons draw moderate energy; more medium slots require a larger energy grid to sustain.
Running multiple medium weapons generates significant heat; manage with HEAT_DISSIPATION.

description: Capacity limit for large weapon and module hardpoints.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 large hardpoint slot.

interactions.effect: Large weapons are high energy consumers; insufficient grid causes brown-outs reducing fire rate.
Large slots typically host explosive weapons; BLAST_RADIUS tags scale their AoE coverage.

description: Capacity limit for XL and heavy weapon hardpoints.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 XL hardpoint slot. XL weapons are the highest damage single emplacements in the game.

interactions.effect: XL weapons are extreme energy draws; a dedicated energy grid build is required to fire them consistently.
XL weapons with pierce tags can cut through entire enemy formations in a single shot.

description: Resource and currency storage limit during a sector run.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20 cargo units. Determines how much sector currency and resources can be carried before overflow.

interactions.effect: Scrap Salvager generates debris resources that consume cargo; higher capacity prevents early overflow loss.
ON_KILL triggers that grant resources benefit from larger cargo pools.

description: Rate at which weapon and engine heat is cooled down.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8 heat/s cooling rate. Prevents overheat lockout on weapons.

interactions.effect: Net heat = HEAT_GEN minus HEAT_DISSIPATION. Surplus dissipation enables sustained fire without overheat.
Hyper-Conductor builds deliberately run high heat; HEAT_DISSIPATION controls the conversion rate to VOLTAGE output.
Lower dissipation makes ON_OVERHEAT triggers fire more frequently — useful in deliberate overheat builds.

description: Total power capacity available to run active modules and weapons.
mechanic: Each tag adds +40 energy to the grid pool. Weapons draw from this pool each shot; when empty, fire rate drops.

interactions.effect: Reducing energy cost per shot lets the same grid sustain far higher fire rates.
Overclock burns energy reserves for a stat burst; a larger grid extends overclock uptime.
RESOURCE_FEED transfers energy to an ally — only useful if your own grid has surplus to share.

description: Speed of passive or active hull restoration.
mechanic: Each tag adds +5 HP/s to passive hull repair rate.

interactions.effect: Higher hull pools mean repair rate takes longer to fully restore; both must scale together.
Nanite swarms add burst hull restoration on top of passive repair rate — they stack.
Repair swarm constructs add additional repair output that stacks with the base REPAIR_RATE.

description: Laser and plasma weapon damage type.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8% damage to all energy-type weapons.

interactions.effect: Mirror prisms reflect energy beams; reflected shots inherit ENERGY tag bonuses.
Prism-split beams each carry full ENERGY tag bonuses on their split copies.
Energy weapons can carry EMP payloads; ENERGY tags boost the base damage while EMP tags extend disable duration.

description: Ballistic and railgun weapon damage type.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8% damage to all kinetic-type weapons.

interactions.effect: Kinetic rounds with pierce tags punch through multiple hulls — common railgun build path.
High-mass ships firing kinetic weapons create recoil effects that can be converted into positioning tools.
Kinetic damage is reduced by ARMOR; target armor must be stripped with CORROSIVE first for maximum effect.

description: Missile and area-of-effect blast damage type.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8% damage to all explosive-type weapons.

interactions.effect: BLAST_RADIUS tags expand AoE coverage — core scaling stat for explosive builds.
Graviton compression clusters enemies; explosives in a compressed cluster hit all targets simultaneously.
Singularity pulls enemies into the blast zone before detonation — devastating combo.

description: Direct bypass and status-based damage that ignores a portion of shields and armor.
mechanic: Each tag adds +10% shield and armor bypass — damage deals a fraction directly to hull.

interactions.effect: Psionic damage dealt to one tethered target partially bypasses the targets' defenses via the link.
Damage shared along tether links also inherits bypass properties from PSIONIC tags.

description: Nanite and corrosion-based damage that spreads over time.
mechanic: Each tag adds +6 corrosion DPS stacked on the target.

interactions.effect: Nanite specialization amplifies biological payloads; NANITE tags increase biological DPS on afflicted targets.
Infestation spreads biological effects to nearby enemies from a dying host.
Extends the duration of biological DOT stacks, dramatically increasing total damage per application.

description: Armor-stripping damage that reduces target armor rating.
mechanic: Each tag applies -3% armor reduction per stack on the target. Maximum 5 stacks (up to -15% armor).

interactions.effect: CORROSIVE strips armor so kinetic damage bypasses reduction — the standard armor-break combo.
Corrosive stacks and biological DOT both apply from the same hit; they stack independently.
Each corrosive hit applies a stack; ON_HIT triggers can proc off each individual stack application.

description: Firing frequency and attack cadence.
mechanic: Each tag adds +12% to fire rate for all equipped weapons.

interactions.effect: Higher fire rate increases total heat output per second — essential to track in heat-sensitive builds.
More shots per second drains the energy grid faster; offset with ENERGY_COST reduction.
More shots means more ON_HIT trigger opportunities per second.

description: Time required to replenish ammo or charge between salvos.
mechanic: Each tag reduces reload time by 15%.

interactions.effect: Larger magazines reduce reload frequency; RELOAD_SPEED makes the mandatory reloads faster.
Chrono Architect COOLDOWN tags reduce ability cooldowns; RELOAD_SPEED covers weapon cycle gaps.

description: Magazine or salvo size before a reload is required.
mechanic: Each tag adds +2 shots to the magazine before reload triggers.

interactions.effect: More ammo delays reloads; faster reloads recover the gap — both contribute to sustained DPS.
Higher fire rates burn through larger magazines faster; ammo capacity must scale with fire rate.

description: Power drawn from the energy grid per shot fired.
mechanic: Each tag reduces energy cost per shot by 8%.

interactions.effect: Lower cost per shot and a larger grid together extend sustained fire time significantly.
Overclock burns energy as a resource; lower shot costs preserve grid for overclock burst windows.

description: Heat generated per shot fired by the weapon.
mechanic: Each tag increases heat output by +15% per shot. Feeds Hyper-Conductor conversion builds.

interactions.effect: Net heat balance = HEAT_GEN minus HEAT_DISSIPATION. Excess heat triggers overheat lockout.
Hyper-Conductor converts accumulated heat directly into VOLTAGE damage output — high HEAT_GEN is intentional in this build.
Deliberately stacking HEAT_GEN enables more frequent ON_OVERHEAT triggers for reactive builds.

description: Speed of launched projectiles.
mechanic: Each tag increases projectile travel speed by +15%.

interactions.effect: Faster projectiles reach maximum range before expiring, effectively extending functional range.
Higher velocity piercing shots pass through enemies faster, reducing the window for targets to leave the path.

description: Spread angle and shot precision.
mechanic: Each tag reduces spread angle by 20%.

interactions.effect: Higher accuracy at long range ensures shots hit their mark rather than diverging before reaching targets.
Rapid fire with high spread creates area coverage; high accuracy focuses damage on single targets.

description: Maximum distance projectiles travel before expiring.
mechanic: Each tag increases weapon range by +15%.

interactions.effect: Anaconda's special tag adds a base 40% range bonus; RANGE tags multiply on top of this.
Singularity pull range can be extended via RANGE tags on spatial constructs.
Reflected beams inherit the original weapon's range; RANGE tags extend how far reflected shots travel.

description: Area of effect diameter for explosive and splash damage.
mechanic: Each tag increases AoE radius by +20%.

interactions.effect: Compressed enemy clusters caught inside a large blast radius take full damage simultaneously.
Singularity radius scales with BLAST_RADIUS tags — larger pull fields.
EXPLOSIVE type tags boost base damage; BLAST_RADIUS scales how many targets that damage hits.

description: Number of enemy ships a projectile passes through before stopping.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 pierce count (enemy ships the shot can pass through).

interactions.effect: A piercing shot can apply a tether to each enemy it passes through in sequence.
Piercing corrosive shots apply armor-strip stacks to every enemy in the line.
Compressed clusters maximise pierce value — a single shot through compressed enemies hits all of them.

description: Number of times a projectile bounces off targets, prisms, or debris.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 bounce. Each bounce retains 70% of the previous hit's damage.

interactions.effect: Mirror prisms redirect ricochets at new angles — ricochet + mirror creates complex multi-target geometry.
Scrap Salvager debris fields act as ricochet surfaces, converting barriers into offensive geometry.
After a prism split, each beam copy can independently ricochet, multiplying total bounce coverage.

description: Continuous thermal damage over time applied to a target.
mechanic: Each tag adds +12 thermal DPS and +0.5s to burn duration.

interactions.effect: Burning enemies radiate heat — in close range engagements this feeds Hyper-Conductor conversion.
DOT_DURATION tags extend burn duration significantly, multiplying total damage per application.
Nanite infestation spreading through a burning enemy carries the burn status to the next host.

description: Slows enemy movement and attack speeds.
mechanic: Each tag reduces target movement speed by -10% and extends freeze duration by +0.3s.

interactions.effect: Frozen enemies cannot drift out of a singularity pull — freeze locks them in place for full duration.
Freeze slows enemies trying to scatter after compression ends, extending cluster window.
A freezing piercing shot can slow an entire column of enemies in one pass.

description: Disables enemy shields and automated targeting routines.
mechanic: Each tag adds +0.8s to EMP disable duration. Disabled enemies cannot regenerate shields or fire weapons.

interactions.effect: Hyper-Conductor VOLTAGE damage pairs with EMP — EMP drops shields, then VOLTAGE deals direct damage.
EMP applied to a tethered target propagates the disable along the chain to all linked enemies.
EMP forces shields to zero, reliably triggering ON_SHIELD_DROP logic modules.

description: Probability of dealing a bonus damage multiplier on a hit.
mechanic: Each tag adds +5% critical hit chance. Crits deal 2× base damage.

interactions.effect: More frequent crits trigger ON_CRIT logic modules more often — reactive crit builds require both.
Critical hits that echo via DAMAGE_SHARE also apply the crit multiplier to all linked targets.
A critical hit echoed by TEMPORAL_ECHO duplicates the crit damage burst after a short delay.

description: Length of time all status effects persist on a target.
mechanic: Each tag adds +0.5s to the duration of all active status effects (BURN, FREEZE, EMP, BIOLOGICAL, CORROSIVE).

interactions.effect: Burn duration extension has the highest DPS return — each extra second multiplies total fire damage.
Longer status durations give infestation more time to spread before the host is destroyed.
Extended corrosive stacks remain active longer, allowing more subsequent hits to benefit from reduced armor.

description: Maximum number of active drones or construct minions allowed simultaneously.
mechanic: Each tag raises the active drone cap by +1.

interactions.effect: More drones with higher damage output scales total DPS multiplicatively.
More drones in repair mode provide higher total HP/s restoration to the team.
Each active nanite drone delivers payload independently; more drones equals more simultaneous nanite coverage.

description: Health pool of each deployed construct.
mechanic: Each tag adds +150 HP to all active drones.

interactions.effect: Tankier drones survive longer, reducing the frequency of respawn cooldowns.
Kamikaze drones do not benefit from hull; these tags are mutually exclusive in efficient builds.

description: Movement and tracking velocity of deployed constructs.
mechanic: Each tag increases drone movement speed by +20%.

interactions.effect: Faster kamikaze drones close distance before targets can evade — speed is primary for this behavior.
Faster repair drones reach damaged allies sooner, reducing downtime between repairs.

description: Offensive output of deployed constructs.
mechanic: Each tag increases drone weapon damage by +15%.

interactions.effect: Damage scales per drone; more drones multiply the benefit of each DRONE_DAMAGE tag.
Beaconed targets receive bonus damage from all sources including drones.

description: Cooldown time before a destroyed drone is rebuilt and redeployed.
mechanic: Each tag reduces respawn cooldown by 1.5s.

interactions.effect: A large drone fleet with fast respawn maintains near-maximum active count even under fire.
ON_KILL triggers can reset respawn cooldowns when slotted with the appropriate logic module.

description: Constructs orbit the parent vessel, rotating around it as a defensive layer.
mechanic: Each tag increases orbital radius by +10% and collision damage from orbiting constructs by +5%.

interactions.effect: Higher ship mass at the orbital center increases the impact force of constructs making contact with enemies.
Scrap Salvager debris can orbit the ship, combining ORBITAL behavior with physical barrier properties.

description: Constructs detonate on contact with an enemy target.
mechanic: Each tag increases kamikaze detonation damage by +40%.

interactions.effect: Faster kamikaze drones reach targets before they can evade — speed is the primary enabling stat.
BLAST_RADIUS tags extend kamikaze explosion area, increasing targets hit per detonation.
Fast respawn maintains kamikaze supply for continuous sacrifice waves.

description: Constructs prioritise intercepting incoming enemy missiles and projectiles.
mechanic: Each tag increases interception accuracy by +15%.

interactions.effect: Faster point-defense drones intercept faster-moving projectiles reliably.
Point defense reduces incoming damage that would otherwise drain shields — both protect the hull.

description: Constructs prioritise restoring hull HP to damaged allied ships.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8 HP/s team repair output from all active repair constructs.

interactions.effect: More repair drones means more simultaneous repair beams — output scales with drone count.
REPAIR_SWARM stacks additively with base REPAIR_RATE for total hull restoration.
Nanite swarms and repair drones together create a stacked restoration layer — burst (nanite) plus sustained (repair).

description: Constructs mark high-priority targets, granting allies bonus damage against them.
mechanic: Each tag adds +10% bonus damage that all allies deal to beaconed targets.

interactions.effect: Beaconed targets take bonus damage from direct hits; DAMAGE_SHARE echoes that bonus to tethered enemies.
A tethered, beaconed target creates a focus-fire node where all damage is amplified and echoed.

description: Gravitational pull and force field mechanics.
mechanic: Each tag adds +15% to pull force magnitude and +10% to pull field radius.

interactions.effect: GRAVITY pulls enemies in; COMPRESSION holds them dense. The two tags work sequentially for maximum effect.
GRAVITY tags amplify singularity pull force and field radius simultaneously.
Singularity fields scale their radius from BLAST_RADIUS tags — pulls more enemies into the cluster.

description: Creates a temporary black hole that pulls all nearby enemies inward.
mechanic: Each tag adds +0.8s to singularity duration and +12% to singularity damage.

interactions.effect: GRAVITY tags amplify the singularity's pull force and field size.
Singularity pulls enemies together; COMPRESSION holds them compressed after the singularity expires.
Detonating an explosive inside an active singularity hits all compressed enemies simultaneously.

description: Strength of the gravitational suction effect applied to enemies.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20 force units to pull strength, affecting how quickly enemies are drawn in.

interactions.effect: Heavier enemies resist pull; higher PULL_FORCE values overcome this resistance.
Frozen enemies move slower and resist pull less — FREEZE and PULL_FORCE combine for guaranteed clustering.

description: Holds clustered enemies in a dense formation, amplifying area damage.
mechanic: Each tag increases compression damage bonus by +15% (the denser the cluster, the more bonus damage it receives).

interactions.effect: GRAVITY creates the cluster; COMPRESSION keeps it dense and punishes it.
Explosives inside a compressed cluster hit every target for full blast damage.
Piercing shots through a compressed cluster hit every enemy in the line at full damage.

description: Knockback and force vector applied to enemies or allies.
mechanic: Each tag adds +15% to displacement force magnitude.

interactions.effect: Higher-mass enemies resist displacement; more DISPLACEMENT tags are needed to move heavy targets.
Displaced enemies collide with debris fields, taking impact damage in addition to the displacement force.

description: Time distortion field affecting the speed of all events within its radius.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8% time distortion field strength — allies in range gain proportional speed bonuses to all actions.

interactions.effect: CHRONO scales field strength; EXECUTION_SPEED specifically targets automation loop tick rates within it.
AURA_RADIUS expands how far the CHRONO distortion field reaches.
FREQUENCY increases how often the CHRONO field pulses its effect on ally logic loops.

description: Flat reduction applied to ability and module cooldowns.
mechanic: Each tag reduces all ability cooldowns by 6%.

interactions.effect: Phase state has a cooldown; COOLDOWN reduction enables more frequent invulnerability windows.
Faster blink cooldowns enable rapid repositioning in succession.
Singularity cooldown reduction means gravity clusters can be deployed more aggressively.

description: Increases the tick rate of automated combat logic loops.
mechanic: Each tag increases automation loop frequency by +10% — logic conditions are evaluated and triggered faster.

interactions.effect: CHRONO field strength amplifies the radius in which EXECUTION_SPEED benefits apply to allies.
FREQUENCY and EXECUTION_SPEED both accelerate loop timing but affect different systems — they stack.
Faster execution means ON_HIT triggers fire sooner after each hit event, reducing reaction latency.

description: Tick rate of recurring aura pulses and periodic effects.
mechanic: Each tag increases the pulse frequency of all periodic effects by +12%.

interactions.effect: More frequent resonance pulses stack HARMONIC faster, accelerating the exponential multiplier.
Higher frequency repair pulses from constructs restore more HP per second.
BROADCAST pulses buffs to allies at the FREQUENCY tick rate — higher frequency means more consistent buff uptime.

description: Effective spatial size of aura and field effects.
mechanic: Each tag adds +25u to the radius of all aura-based effects.

interactions.effect: AURA_RADIUS expands the zone where CHRONO distortion benefits apply to allies.
BROADCAST range scales with AURA_RADIUS — larger radius reaches more allies.
Scrap Salvager debris fields have an effective radius; AURA_RADIUS tags extend their coverage.

description: Duplicates a triggered logic effect after a short time delay.
mechanic: Each tag adds +12% chance for any triggered effect to be duplicated 0.8s later.

interactions.effect: Kill effects duplicated by TEMPORAL_ECHO grant a second proc of any on-kill reward or trigger.
Critical hits echoed by TEMPORAL_ECHO repeat the crit damage burst on the same target.
Echoed damage events also trigger DAMAGE_SHARE propagation to tethered targets.

description: Connects two or more targets with a force line that transmits effects.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 simultaneous tether link and +15% tether range.

interactions.effect: TETHER establishes the link; CHAIN determines how many times effects jump along the connected network.
All targets linked by TETHER share damage dealt to any single one of them.
A piercing shot can apply a fresh tether link to each enemy it passes through.

description: Splits damage dealt or received across all tethered targets.
mechanic: Each tag causes +8% of damage dealt to one tethered target to echo to every other linked target.

interactions.effect: DAMAGE_SHARE requires active tether links to propagate — more tethers = more echo targets.
A crit's multiplied damage also echoes — DAMAGE_SHARE amplifies the value of every critical hit.
Psionic bypass is inherited by echoed damage — tethered targets take bypass damage even if not hit directly.

description: Shares a locally active buff or stat with all allies within broadcast range.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20u to broadcast range and enables +1 additional buff type to be shared simultaneously.

interactions.effect: AURA_RADIUS and BROADCAST both extend range — they stack for maximum coverage.
AMPLIFICATION multiplies the value of the buff being broadcast — more range plus higher multiplier.
HARMONIC stacks can be broadcast to nearby allies, sharing the exponential multiplier benefit.

description: Transfers heat or energy reserves directly to an allied ship.
mechanic: Each tag transfers +12% of excess heat or energy per second to the nearest ally in range.

interactions.effect: A large energy grid creates surplus that RESOURCE_FEED can transfer to an ally who needs it.
Mamba feeding heat to a Hyper-Conductor ally via RESOURCE_FEED directly charges VOLTAGE output.
Ships with excess dissipation can offload heat to a Hyper-Conductor ally to fuel their damage cycle.

description: Applies a stat multiplier to allies within aura range.
mechanic: Each tag adds +8% to the stat multiplier applied to all allies inside the aura.

interactions.effect: BROADCAST range determines who receives the AMPLIFICATION — extend both for maximum team coverage.
HARMONIC stacks multiply the AMPLIFICATION output exponentially at high stack counts.
The amplification aura pulses at FREQUENCY rate — higher frequency means more consistent uptime.

description: Propagates damage or status effects along active tether links between targets.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 chain jump and retains +10% more damage per jump (default retention is 60% per jump).

interactions.effect: CHAIN requires active tether links to jump along — more tethers create longer and wider chain paths.
EMP status chaining along tether links disables an entire tethered group simultaneously.
CHAIN and DAMAGE_SHARE together create two simultaneous propagation systems — chain jumps and echo splits.

description: Shifts the vessel's hitbox into an alternate dimension, making it temporarily immune to physical damage.
mechanic: Each tag adds +0.3s to phase duration and reduces phase cooldown by 0.8s.

interactions.effect: PHASE provides the hitbox shift; INVULNERABILITY extends the window of complete immunity.
A blink can be performed during an active phase state — repositioning while untouchable.
High evasion reduces how often phase is needed defensively, letting it be used more offensively.

description: Temporary complete immunity to all damage types.
mechanic: Each tag adds +0.2s to invulnerability window duration.

interactions.effect: PHASE enables the hitbox shift; INVULNERABILITY ensures no damage source can reach the ship during the window.
Reducing cooldowns increases how often invulnerability windows can be entered.
Invulnerability triggered by shield drop gives a safe regen window — combine with fast SHIELD_REGEN for cycling.

description: Deploys self-replicating metallic nanite bugs that seek targets autonomously.
mechanic: Each tag increases nanites deployed per pulse by +2.

interactions.effect: NANITE deploys the swarm; INFESTATION determines how many targets the swarm can spread to after a host dies.
Each nanite carries a biological payload — BIOLOGICAL tags increase the damage they deal on contact.
Nanites in repair mode stack with REPAIR_SWARM constructs for layered hull restoration.

description: Collects debris from destroyed enemies to be used as a resource or barrier.
mechanic: Each tag increases the amount of debris collected per enemy destroyed by +15%.

interactions.effect: Collected SALVAGE fuels DEBRIS_FIELD deployments — more salvage means more and larger debris barriers.
Deployed debris acts as a ricochet surface; projectiles bounce off barriers and onto new targets.
Salvaged debris can orbit the ship as a rotating protective ring.

description: Returns a portion of incoming projectile damage back at the attacker.
mechanic: Each tag adds +12% reflected damage multiplier.

interactions.effect: MIRROR prisms redirect reflections at chosen angles; REFLECTION determines their damage multiplier.
Shields absorb incoming shots; REFLECTION returns damage even from shots that were fully shielded.
Reflected energy beams inherit ENERGY type bonuses from the defender's build, not the attacker's.

description: Deploys a floating prism that redirects incoming projectiles at a new angle.
mechanic: Each tag deploys +1 active mirror prism. Mirrors persist until destroyed or manually repositioned.

interactions.effect: MIRROR bounces beams at a new angle; PRISM splits each bounce into multiple diverging copies.
Projectiles bouncing off mirrors consume one ricochet count, allowing further bounces.
Mirrors amplify reflections by directing returned fire more precisely at attacker positions.

description: Spreads active nanite effects from a dying host to nearby targets.
mechanic: Each tag allows infestation to spread to +1 additional nearby target on host death.

interactions.effect: NANITE determines the swarm payload; INFESTATION determines how far the swarm propagates on host death.
Kill events trigger infestation spread — ON_KILL logic modules can chain with infestation for cascading effects.
Biological status carried by nanites spreads to each new infestation target.

description: Short-range positional teleport that repositions the ship instantly.
mechanic: Each tag reduces blink cooldown by 0.5s and extends blink range by +20u.

interactions.effect: Blinking during an active phase state allows repositioning while remaining untouchable.
COOLDOWN tags stack with BLINK's own cooldown reduction for very frequent repositioning.
High acceleration lets the ship exploit blink repositioning immediately without losing momentum.

description: Splits a single beam into multiple diverging beams at point of contact.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 beam split. Each split beam deals 60% of the parent beam's damage.

interactions.effect: Mirror redirects beams; PRISM splits them. A beam bounced by a mirror can then be split by a prism.
Each split beam copy can independently ricochet, compounding total bounce coverage geometrically.
All split beams inherit the parent beam's ENERGY type tags for full damage bonuses.

description: Deploys collected wreckage as persistent area hazards or physical barriers.
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 debris piece deployed and +15% to barrier HP.

interactions.effect: SALVAGE collection rate determines how much debris is available to deploy as fields.
Projectiles ricochet off deployed debris, turning barriers into offensive geometry.
AURA_RADIUS extends the zone covered by debris field deployments.

description: Raw electrical damage output converted from heat and energy pressure.
mechanic: Each tag adds +15% to electrical damage output. Unlike EMP, VOLTAGE deals direct damage rather than disabling systems.

interactions.effect: Heat generated by weapons is the raw fuel for VOLTAGE — higher heat output equals more electrical damage potential.
EMP disables shields; VOLTAGE then deals direct electrical damage with no shield absorbing it.
OVERCLOCK burns energy to temporarily spike VOLTAGE output significantly above baseline.

description: Temporary stat burst fuelled by burning energy reserves.
mechanic: Each tag increases burst magnitude by +8% and extends overclock duration by +0.3s.

interactions.effect: Overclock consumes energy reserves — a larger grid sustains longer and more frequent overclock windows.
OVERCLOCK primarily spikes VOLTAGE output during the burst window — the two tags define Hyper-Conductor's peak damage.
Cooldown reduction lets overclock cycles fire more frequently, extending total burst uptime.

description: Stacking resonance multiplier — each stack amplifies all other stacks exponentially.
mechanic: Each tag adds +6% per-stack resonance multiplier. At 5 stacks: 1.06^5 ≈ 1.34× all aura effects. At 10 stacks: 1.06^10 ≈ 1.79×.

interactions.effect: Higher frequency pulses accumulate HARMONIC stacks faster, reaching exponential territory sooner.
HARMONIC stacks multiply the AMPLIFICATION output — stacking both creates compounding team buff value.
Sharing HARMONIC stacks via BROADCAST gives allies the exponential multiplier benefit directly.

description: Deploys collected wreckage as persistent area hazards or physical barriers. (Listed under EXOTIC — mirrored here for subcategory reference.)
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 debris piece deployed and +15% barrier HP.

interactions.effect: SALVAGE fuels the debris pool; DEBRIS_FIELD spends it on deployments.
Debris fields can orbit the ship as a rotating defensive ring.
Projectiles bounce off debris field barriers onto new targets.

description: Splits a single beam into multiple diverging beams. (Listed under EXOTIC — mirrored here for subcategory reference.)
mechanic: Each tag adds +1 beam split at 60% damage per copy.

interactions.effect: Mirror and prism chain together — bounce then split or split then bounce.
Each split copy can independently ricochet, multiplying coverage geometrically.
All copies inherit ENERGY type damage bonuses from the parent beam.

description: Triggers a logic module when any hit is dealt or received.
mechanic: Each tag allows +1 additional logic module to execute simultaneously on this event.

interactions.effect: Higher fire rate means more ON_HIT events per second, accelerating all attached trigger effects.
Chain propagates ON_HIT effects along tether networks — one hit triggers the chain to all linked enemies.
Each corrosive stack application fires as an individual ON_HIT event.

description: Triggers a logic module when a critical strike is landed.
mechanic: Each tag adds +15% bonus effect magnitude to any module triggered by a critical hit.

interactions.effect: More frequent crits means more ON_CRIT trigger opportunities — both tags must scale together.
Critical hits echoed via DAMAGE_SHARE also fire ON_CRIT triggers on the echo target.
TEMPORAL_ECHO duplicating a crit event fires ON_CRIT a second time after the delay.

description: Triggers a logic module when an enemy ship is destroyed.
mechanic: Each tag allows +1 additional logic module to trigger on kill, and extends kill proc effect duration by +8%.

interactions.effect: Kill events trigger infestation spread — ON_KILL and INFESTATION chain for cascading nanite propagation.
ON_KILL is when debris is generated; higher kill rates directly feed Scrap Salvager collection.
A kill effect duplicated by TEMPORAL_ECHO fires twice — once on kill, once 0.8s later.

description: Triggers a logic module when shields reach exactly 0 SP.
mechanic: Each tag allows +1 additional logic module to trigger when shields drop.

interactions.effect: Phase Weaver triggering on shield drop creates an invulnerability window exactly when most needed.
EMP reliably forces shields to zero, creating predictable and controllable ON_SHIELD_DROP trigger windows.
Fast shield regen after a drop resets the condition quickly, enabling repeated trigger cycling.

description: Triggers a logic module when heat reaches 100% capacity.
mechanic: Each tag reduces the cooldown on heat-triggered abilities by 5s.

interactions.effect: Stacking HEAT_GEN intentionally reaches overheat faster, triggering ON_OVERHEAT more frequently.
ON_OVERHEAT is the primary discharge trigger for Hyper-Conductor VOLTAGE bursts.
Deliberately limiting dissipation allows overheat to trigger on a controlled schedule.

description: Triggers when a target enters a defined detection radius.
mechanic: Each tag adds +20u to the detection radius for IN_RANGE triggers.

interactions.effect: AURA_RADIUS and IN_RANGE both define spatial zones — expanding one often benefits the other in aura-trigger builds.
IN_RANGE can automatically initiate a tether when a target enters the detection zone.

description: Triggers when this ship is positioned in the rear arc of a teammate.
mechanic: Each tag adds +12% bonus effect magnitude to modules triggered from the behind-ally position.

interactions.effect: Positioned behind an ally, RESOURCE_FEED transfers heat or energy at higher efficiency.
Broadcast from behind-ally position benefits from positional bonus — coordinated fleet formation matters.

description: Triggers when a target or event occurs within the front 90° cone of the ship.
mechanic: Each tag widens the frontal arc by +15° (base 90°, max 180°).

interactions.effect: Higher turn speed makes it easier to keep targets inside the frontal arc for trigger conditions.
Mirror prisms placed in the frontal arc redirect fire into a wide coverage zone.

description: Triggers based on closeness to the nearest enemy or ally entity.
mechanic: Each tag adds +15u to the proximity detection radius.

interactions.effect: Orbital constructs operate at close range — PROXIMITY triggers align naturally with orbital build conditions.
Proximity-triggered debris field deployment creates reactive barrier placement when enemies close in.
Proximity triggers fire as a compressed cluster forms — useful for detonating area effects at peak density.

description: Triggers when a teammate's hull drops below a defined HP threshold.
mechanic: Each tag raises the HP threshold at which this trigger fires by +5% of max HP, making it trigger earlier.

interactions.effect: ALLY_LOW_HP triggering a repair swarm dispatch is the primary sustain logic loop in support builds.
Phase Weaver using ALLY_LOW_HP to trigger a team phase field saves allies from lethal damage.
RESOURCE_FEED redirected to a low-HP ally in response to ALLY_LOW_HP provides emergency energy for their defenses.

description: Triggers when an ally is locked on by one or more enemies.
mechanic: Each tag allows +1 additional ally to simultaneously trigger this condition.

interactions.effect: When an ally is targeted, auto-tethering attackers redirects damage share back to them.
Triggering phase when an ally is targeted provides temporary protection before incoming shots land.

description: Triggers when all player ships are positioned within a close grouping radius.
mechanic: Each tag increases the cluster detection radius by +15u — easier to maintain the trigger condition.

interactions.effect: HARMONIC stacks accumulate faster when TEAM_CLUSTER is maintained — formation play rewards compound scaling.
BROADCAST range determines who receives buffs; TEAM_CLUSTER confirms both ships are in range.
Clustered ships trigger amplification on each other simultaneously — peak buff output requires tight formation.
